title: पञ्चनवतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 95 · The sages and the lotus stalks

summary.en: Atri and the seven sages wander the forest living on roots and fruits, and the great sage's followers find that their lotus stalks are gone. Each, with his own oath, swears that he is not the thief, and Shunahsakha, the dog-friend, curses the thief with a terrible oath, until the stalks are revealed to have been hidden by Indra to test them.
summary.kn: ಅತ್ರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಪ್ತರ್ಷಿಗಳು ಬೇರು-ಹಣ್ಣು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಾ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಚರಿಸುವಾಗ ತಾವರೆ ದಂಟುಗಳು ಕಾಣೆಯಾದವು. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ತಾನು ಕಳ್ಳನಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ತನ್ನದೇ ಆಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಶುನಃಸಖ ಭಯಂಕರ ಆಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಇಂದ್ರ ಅವನ್ನು ಅಡಗಿಸಿದ್ದನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: अत्रि और सप्तर्षि कन्द-फल खाते वन में विचरते हैं और उनके कमलनाल गायब हो जाते हैं। हर एक अपनी शपथ से कहता है कि वह चोर नहीं, शुनःसख भयंकर शपथ लेता है, और अन्त में पता चलता है कि इन्द्र ने उन्हें परखने को छिपाया था।
summary.te: అత్రి, సప్తర్షులు దుంపలు, పండ్లు తింటూ అడవిలో సంచరిస్తుండగా వారి తామర కాడలు కనిపించకపోయాయి. ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ తన ప్రమాణంతో తాను దొంగ కాదని అంటారు, శునఃసఖుడు భయంకర ప్రమాణం చేస్తాడు, చివరకు వారిని పరీక్షించడానికి ఇంద్రుడు వాటిని దాచాడని తెలుస్తుంది.
summary.ta: அத்ரியும் ஏழு முனிவரும் கிழங்கும் கனியும் உண்டு காட்டில் திரிகையில் அவர்களின் தாமரைத் தண்டுகள் காணாமல் போகின்றன. ஒவ்வொருவரும் தம் சூளுரையால் தான் திருடனல்ல என்று கூறுகின்றனர், சுனஸ்சகன் கொடிய சூளுரை செய்கிறான், இறுதியில் அவர்களைச் சோதிக்க இந்திரன் அவற்றை மறைத்தான் என்று தெரிகிறது.
summary.ml: അത്രിയും സപ്തർഷികളും വേരും ഫലവും ഭക്ഷിച്ച് കാട്ടിൽ അലയുന്നു; മഹർഷിയുടെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ തങ്ങളുടെ താമരത്തണ്ടുകൾ കാണാനില്ലെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു. ഓരോരുത്തരും തന്റെ വ്രതമനുസരിച്ച് താൻ മോഷ്ടാവല്ലെന്ന് സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു; നായയുടെ സുഹൃത്തായ ശുനഃസഖൻ ഭയങ്കരമായ സത്യത്തോടെ മോഷ്ടാവിനെ ശപിക്കുന്നു; ഒടുവിൽ, അവരെ പരീക്ഷിക്കാൻ ഇന്ദ്രൻ ഒളിപ്പിച്ചതാണ് താമരത്തണ്ടുകളെന്ന് വെളിപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.95; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अथात्रिप्रमुखा राजन्वने तस्मिन्महर्षयः ।
व्यचरन्भक्षयन्तो वै मूलानि च फलानि च ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, Atri and the other great sages wandered through that forest, living on roots and fruits.

verses.text:
अथापश्यन्सुपीनांसपाणिपादमुखोदरम् ।
परिव्रजन्तं स्थूलाङ्गं परिव्राजं शुनःसखम् ॥

meaning.en: There they saw a wandering mendicant, Shunahsakha, plump in shoulders, hands, feet, face and belly, stout of limb, going about the forest.

verses.text:
अरुन्धती तु तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वाङ्गोपचितं शुभा ।
भवितारो भवन्तो वै नैवमित्यब्रवीदृषीन् ॥

meaning.en: Fair Arundhati saw him, fat in every limb, and said to the sages, "You are not like this."

verses.text: वसिष्ठ उवाच

meaning.en: Vasishtha said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकमग्निहोत्रमनिर्हुतम् ।
सायं प्रातश्च होतव्यं तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He has no agnihotra left unoffered, as we do, to be poured at dusk and dawn; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: अत्रिरुवाच

meaning.en: Atri said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं क्षुधा वीर्यं समाहतम् ।
कृच्छ्राधीतं प्रनष्टं च तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: His strength is not worn down by hunger as ours is, nor has he lost what he learned with hardship; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: विश्वामित्र उवाच

meaning.en: Vishvamitra said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं शश्वच्छास्त्रं जरद्गवः ।
अलसः क्षुत्परो मूर्खस्तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He has no ever-present scripture to study as we do; he is an idle, food-hungry fool, an old ox; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: जमदग्निरुवाच

meaning.en: Jamadagni said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं भक्तमिन्धनमेव च ।
संचिन्त्य वार्षिकं किंचित्तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He does not worry as we do about food and firewood, or about providing something for the rainy season; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं चत्वारश्च सहोदराः ।
देहि देहीति भिक्षन्ति तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He has no four brothers, as we have, begging "give, give"; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: भरद्वाज उवाच

meaning.en: Bharadvaja said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं ब्रह्मबन्धोरचेतसः ।
शोको भार्यापवादेन तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He, a mindless Brahmin in name only, has no grief over a wife's reproach, as we have; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: गौतम उवाच

meaning.en: Gautama said:

verses.text:
नैतस्येह यथास्माकं त्रिकौशेयं हि राङ्कवम् ।
एकैकं वै त्रिवार्षीयं तेन पीवाञ्शुनःसखः ॥

meaning.en: He has no triple silk garment or deerskin to keep for three years, one for each, as we have; that is why this friend of dogs is fat.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अथ दृष्ट्वा परिव्राट्स तान्महर्षीञ्शुनःसखः ।
अभिगम्य यथान्यायं पाणिस्पर्शमथाचरत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mendicant Shunahsakha, seeing those great sages, approached them and duly greeted them with a touch of the hand.

verses.text:
परिचर्यां वने तां तु क्षुत्प्रतीघातकारिकाम् ।
अन्योन्येन निवेद्याथ प्रातिष्ठन्त सहैव ते ॥

meaning.en: In the forest they told one another of that service which removes hunger, and then they all set out together.

verses.text:
एकनिश्चयकार्याश्च व्यचरन्त वनानि ते ।
आददानाः समुद्धृत्य मूलानि च फलानि च ॥

meaning.en: United in purpose, they roamed the forests, gathering roots and fruits that they dug up.

verses.text:
कदाचिद्विचरन्तस्ते वृक्षैरविरलैर्वृताम् ।
शुचिवारिप्रसन्नोदां ददृशुः पद्मिनीं शुभाम् ॥

meaning.en: Once, as they wandered, they saw a lovely lotus pond ringed with dense trees, its water clear and pure.

verses.text:
बालादित्यवपुःप्रख्यैः पुष्करैरुपशोभिताम् ।
वैदूर्यवर्णसदृशैः पद्मपत्रैरथावृताम् ॥

meaning.en: It was adorned with lotuses bright as the morning sun and covered with lotus leaves the colour of lapis lazuli.

verses.text:
नानाविधैश्च विहगैर्जलप्रकरसेविभिः ।
एकद्वारामनादेयां सूपतीर्थामकर्दमाम् ॥

meaning.en: It was frequented by many kinds of water birds, had a single entrance, was unfrequented by others, with a good landing and no mud.

verses.text:
वृषादर्भिप्रयुक्ता तु कृत्या विकृतदर्शना ।
यातुधानीति विख्याता पद्मिनीं तामरक्षत ॥

meaning.en: But a fearsome-looking demoness, a Kritya sent by Vrishadarbhi and known as Yatudhani, guarded that pond.

verses.text:
शुनःसखसहायास्तु बिसार्थं ते महर्षयः ।
पद्मिनीमभिजग्मुस्ते सर्वे कृत्याभिरक्षिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Aided by Shunahsakha, those great sages all went to the lotus pond guarded by the Kritya, in search of lotus stalks.

verses.text:
ततस्ते यातुधानीं तां दृष्ट्वा विकृतदर्शनाम् ।
स्थितां कमलिनीतीरे कृत्यामूचुर्महर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that hideous Yatudhani standing on the bank of the pond, the great sages spoke to the Kritya.

verses.text:
एका तिष्ठसि का नु त्वं कस्यार्थे किं प्रयोजनम् ।
पद्मिनीतीरमाश्रित्य ब्रूहि त्वं किं चिकीर्षसि ॥

meaning.en: "You stand alone. Who are you, for whom, and for what purpose? Tell us what you want to do, staying here at the lotus pond."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
यास्मि सास्म्यनुयोगो मे न कर्तव्यः कथंचन ।
आरक्षिणीं मां पद्मिन्या वित्त सर्वे तपोधनाः ॥

meaning.en: Whoever I am, I am; you must never question me. Know me, all you rich in austerity, as the guardian of this pond.

verses.text: ऋषय ऊचुः

meaning.en: The sages said:

verses.text:
सर्व एव क्षुधार्ताः स्म न चान्यत्किंचिदस्ति नः ।
भवत्याः संमते सर्वे गृह्णीमहि बिसान्युत ॥

meaning.en: We are all tormented by hunger and have nothing else. With your consent, may we take some lotus stalks?

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
समयेन बिसानीतो गृह्णीध्वं कामकारतः ।
एकैको नाम मे प्रोक्त्वा ततो गृह्णीत माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: You may take the stalks from here at your pleasure, on one condition: each of you must first tell me his name, and then take them without delay.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
विज्ञाय यातुधानीं तां कृत्यामृषिवधैषिणीम् ।
अत्रिः क्षुधापरीतात्मा ततो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Atri, knowing her to be a Yatudhani, a Kritya bent on killing sages, and being overcome by hunger, then spoke.

verses.text:
अरात्रिरत्रेः सा रात्रिर्यां नाधीते त्रिरद्य वै ।
अरात्रिरत्रिरित्येव नाम मे विद्धि शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "That night is no night for Atri in which one does not study three times; know my name, fair one, as Aratri, Atri the one without night."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
यथोदाहृतमेतत्ते मयि नाम महामुने ।
दुर्धार्यमेतन्मनसा गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The name you have told me, great sage, is hard for the mind to hold. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: वसिष्ठ उवाच

meaning.en: Vasishtha said:

verses.text:
वसिष्ठोऽस्मि वरिष्ठोऽस्मि वसे वासं गृहेष्वपि ।
वरिष्ठत्वाच्च वासाच्च वसिष्ठ इति विद्धि माम् ॥

meaning.en: "I am Vasishtha, the best, and I dwell even in houses; know me as Vasishtha, from being best and from dwelling."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
कुलं कुलं च कुपपः कुपयः कश्यपो द्विजः ।
काश्यः काशनिकाशत्वादेतन्मे नाम धारय ॥

meaning.en: "Kula and Kula, Kupapa, Kupaya: I am the twice-born Kashyapa, Kashya through my likeness to a flash of light. Hold this as my name."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
यथोदाहृतमेतत्ते मयि नाम महामुने ।
दुर्धार्यमेतन्मनसा गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The name you have told me, great sage, is hard for the mind to hold. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: भरद्वाज उवाच

meaning.en: Bharadvaja said:

verses.text:
भरे सुतान्भरे शिष्यान्भरे देवान्भरे द्विजान् ।
भरे भार्यामनव्याजो भरद्वाजोऽस्मि शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "I bear my sons, I bear my pupils, I bear gods, I bear Brahmins, and I bear my wife without pretence; I am Bharadvaja, fair one."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: गौतम उवाच

meaning.en: Gautama said:

verses.text:
गोदमो दमगोऽधूमो दमो दुर्दर्शनश्च ते ।
विद्धि मां गौतमं कृत्ये यातुधानि निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: "Godama, Damaga, Adhuma, Dama, Durdarshana: know me as Gautama, Kritya; listen to me, Yatudhani."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
यथोदाहृतमेतत्ते मयि नाम महामुने ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The name you have told me, great sage, cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: विश्वामित्र उवाच

meaning.en: Vishvamitra said:

verses.text:
विश्वेदेवाश्च मे मित्रं मित्रमस्मि गवां तथा ।
विश्वामित्रमिति ख्यातं यातुधानि निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: "The Vishvedevas are my friends, and I am a friend of cows; known as Vishvamitra, listen to me, Yatudhani."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: जमदग्निरुवाच

meaning.en: Jamadagni said:

verses.text:
जाजमद्यजजा नाम मृजा माह जिजायिषे ।
जमदग्निरिति ख्यातमतो मां विद्धि शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "Jajamadyajaja is the name, Mrija, Maha, Jijayishe; therefore know me, fair one, as the renowned Jamadagni."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
यथोदाहृतमेतत्ते मयि नाम महामुने ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The name you have told me, great sage, cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: अरुन्धत्युवाच

meaning.en: Arundhati said:

verses.text:
धरां धरित्रीं वसुधां भर्तुस्तिष्ठाम्यनन्तरम् ।
मनोऽनुरुन्धती भर्तुरिति मां विद्ध्यरुन्धतीम् ॥

meaning.en: "I stay right behind my husband, as the earth, the bearer, the Vasudha; since my mind follows my husband, know me as Arundhati."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: गण्डोवाच

meaning.en: Gandi said:

verses.text:
गण्डं गण्डं गतवती गण्डगण्डेति संज्ञिता ।
गण्डगण्डेव गण्डेति विद्धि मानलसंभवे ॥

meaning.en: "Gandam, Gandam, I have gone, I am called Gandagandi; like Gandagandi, know me as Ganda, born of an idler (or: of Manalasa)."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: पशुसख उवाच

meaning.en: Pashusakha said:

verses.text:
सखा सखे यः सख्येयः पशूनां च सखा सदा ।
गौणं पशुसखेत्येवं विद्धि मामग्निसंभवे ॥

meaning.en: "A friend, O friend, who is to be befriended, and ever a friend of beasts: know me, born of fire, by the figurative name Pashusakha."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नामनैरुक्तमेतत्ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम् ।
नैतद्धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This name-explanation of yours is stated in syllables hard to say; it cannot be kept in mind. Go down into the pond.

verses.text: शुनःसख उवाच

meaning.en: Shunahsakha said:

verses.text:
एभिरुक्तं यथा नाम नाहं वक्तुमिहोत्सहे ।
शुनःसखसखायं मां यातुधान्युपधारय ॥

meaning.en: "I cannot utter the name here as these have spoken it. Yatudhani, understand me as the friend of the friend of dogs."

verses.text: यातुधान्युवाच

meaning.en: The Yatudhani said:

verses.text:
नाम तेऽव्यक्तमुक्तं वै वाक्यं संदिग्धया गिरा ।
तस्मात्सकृदिदानीं त्वं ब्रूहि यन्नाम ते द्विज ॥

meaning.en: The name you spoke was unclear, said in a doubtful voice. So say your name once more now, Brahmin.

verses.text: शुनःसख उवाच

meaning.en: Shunahsakha said:

verses.text:
सकृदुक्तं मया नाम न गृहीतं यदा त्वया ।
तस्मात्त्रिदण्डाभिहता गच्छ भस्मेति माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: "I told you my name once and you did not take it in. Therefore, struck by my triple staff, go to ashes at once."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
सा ब्रह्मदण्डकल्पेन तेन मूर्ध्नि हता तदा ।
कृत्या पपात मेदिन्यां भस्मसाच्च जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: Struck on the head by that staff, which was like a Brahmin's rod of curse, the Kritya fell to the ground and turned to ashes.

verses.text:
शुनःसखश्च हत्वा तां यातुधानीं महाबलाम् ।
भुवि त्रिदण्डं विष्टभ्य शाद्वले समुपाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Having slain that mighty Yatudhani, Shunahsakha planted his triple staff in the earth and sat down on the grass.

verses.text:
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे पुष्कराणि बिसानि च ।
यथाकाममुपादाय समुत्तस्थुर्मुदान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the sages, delighted, took lotus flowers and stalks as they pleased and climbed out of the pond.

verses.text:
श्रमेण महता युक्तास्ते बिसानि कलापशः ।
तीरे निक्षिप्य पद्मिन्यास्तर्पणं चक्रुरम्भसा ॥

meaning.en: Greatly wearied, they laid the stalks in bundles on the bank of the pond and made water offerings with its water.

verses.text:
अथोत्थाय जलात्तस्मात्सर्वे ते वै समागमन् ।
नापश्यंश्चापि ते तानि बिसानि पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then they rose from the water and all came together, but, O best of men, they did not see those stalks.

verses.text: ऋषय ऊचुः

meaning.en: The sages said:

verses.text:
केन क्षुधाभिभूतानामस्माकं पापकर्मणा ।
नृशंसेनापनीतानि बिसान्याहारकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: "Which sinful and cruel person has taken away the stalks of us who were weak with hunger and wanting food?"

verses.text:
ते शङ्कमानास्त्वन्योन्यं पप्रच्छुर्द्विजसत्तमाः ।
त ऊचुः शपथं सर्वे कुर्म इत्यरिकर्शन ॥

meaning.en: The best of Brahmins, suspecting one another, questioned each other; then, O scourge of foes, they all said, "Let us swear oaths."

verses.text:
त उक्त्वा बाढमित्येव सर्व एव शुनःसखम् ।
क्षुधार्ताः सुपरिश्रान्ताः शपथायोपचक्रमुः ॥

meaning.en: Saying "Very well," they all, hungry and exhausted, began to swear oaths in the presence of Shunahsakha.

verses.text: अत्रिरुवाच

meaning.en: Atri said:

verses.text:
स गां स्पृशतु पादेन सूर्यं च प्रतिमेहतु ।
अनध्यायेष्वधीयीत बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him touch a cow with his foot and urinate toward the sun, let him study on forbidden days, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: वसिष्ठ उवाच

meaning.en: Vasishtha said:

verses.text:
अनध्यायपरो लोके शुनः स परिकर्षतु ।
परिव्राट्कामवृत्तोऽस्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him in this world devote himself to forbidden days of study and drag a dog along, let him live as a mendicant by whim, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
शरणागतं हन्तु मित्रं स्वसुतां चोपजीवतु ।
अर्थान्काङ्क्षतु कीनाशाद्बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him kill one who comes for refuge, let him live on his friend and on his own daughter, let him hope for wealth from a miser, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
सर्वत्र सर्वं पणतु न्यासलोपं करोतु च ।
कूटसाक्षित्वमभ्येतु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him trade everything everywhere and deny a deposit, let him bear false witness, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
वृथामांसं समश्नातु वृथादानं करोतु च ।
यातु स्त्रियं दिवा चैव बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him eat meat in vain, make gifts in vain, and lie with a woman by day, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: भरद्वाज उवाच

meaning.en: Bharadvaja said:

verses.text:
नृशंसस्त्यक्तधर्मास्तु स्त्रीषु ज्ञातिषु गोषु च ।
ब्राह्मणं चापि जयतां बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him be cruel, abandon dharma toward women, kin and cows, and even strike a Brahmin, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
उपाध्यायमधः कृत्वा ऋचोऽध्येतु यजूंषि च ।
जुहोतु च स कक्षाग्नौ बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him put his teacher beneath him while he studies the Rig and Yajur Vedas, and let him offer in a fire of dry grass, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: जमदग्निरुवाच

meaning.en: Jamadagni said:

verses.text:
पुरीषमुत्सृजत्वप्सु हन्तु गां चापि दोहिनीम् ।
अनृतौ मैथुनं यातु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him void his dung in water, kill a milch cow, and lie with his wife out of season, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
द्वेष्यो भार्योपजीवी स्याद्दूरबन्धुश्च वैरवान् ।
अन्योन्यस्यातिथिश्चास्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him be hated, live off his wife, have distant kin and enmity, and be a guest to each other in turn, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: गौतम उवाच

meaning.en: Gautama said:

verses.text:
अधीत्य वेदांस्त्यजतु त्रीनग्नीनपविध्यतु ।
विक्रीणातु तथा सोमं बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him abandon the Vedas after learning them, throw away the three fires, and sell Soma, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
उदपानप्लवे ग्रामे ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः ।
तस्य सालोक्यतां यातु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him be a Brahmin husband of a low-caste woman in a village with a well for a ford, and share his world, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: विश्वामित्र उवाच

meaning.en: Vishvamitra said:

verses.text:
जीवतो वै गुरून्भृत्यान्भरन्त्वस्य परे जनाः ।
अगतिर्बहुपुत्रः स्याद्बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let others have to support his living teachers and servants, and let him be helpless with many sons, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
अशुचिर्ब्रह्मकूटोऽस्तु ऋद्ध्या चैवाप्यहंकृतः ।
कर्षको मत्सरी चास्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him be impure, a fraud in sacred matters, proud of his wealth, a farmer and envious, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
वर्षान्करोतु भृतको राज्ञश्चास्तु पुरोहितः ।
अयाज्यस्य भवेदृत्विग्बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him work for hire for years, be the king's priest, and be priest to one unfit to sacrifice, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: अरुन्धत्युवाच

meaning.en: Arundhati said:

verses.text:
नित्यं परिवदेच्छ्वश्रूं भर्तुर्भवतु दुर्मनाः ।
एका स्वादु समश्नातु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति या ॥

meaning.en: "Let her always revile her mother-in-law, be ill-disposed toward her husband, and eat sweet food alone, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
ज्ञातीनां गृहमध्यस्था सक्तूनत्तु दिनक्षये ।
अभाग्यावीरसूरस्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति या ॥

meaning.en: "Let her stay among her relatives' houses and eat barley meal at day's end, unlucky and mother of no heroes, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: गण्डोवाच

meaning.en: Gandi said:

verses.text:
अनृतं भाषतु सदा साधुभिश्च विरुध्यतु ।
ददातु कन्यां शुल्केन बिसस्तैन्यं करोति या ॥

meaning.en: "Let her always speak falsehood, quarrel with the good, and give away a daughter for a bride-price, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text:
साधयित्वा स्वयं प्राशेद्दास्ये जीवतु चैव ह ।
विकर्मणा प्रमीयेत बिसस्तैन्यं करोति या ॥

meaning.en: "Let her cook and eat it herself, live in servitude, and die by a wrongful act, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: पशुसख उवाच

meaning.en: Pashusakha said:

verses.text:
दास्य एव प्रजायेत सोऽप्रसूतिरकिंचनः ।
दैवतेष्वनमस्कारो बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः ॥

meaning.en: "Let him be born a slave, childless and penniless, and without reverence to the gods, who has stolen the lotus stalks."

verses.text: शुनःसख उवाच

meaning.en: Shunahsakha said:

verses.text:
अध्वर्यवे दुहितरं ददातु
च्छन्दोगे वा चरितब्रह्मचर्ये ।
आथर्वणं वेदमधीत्य विप्रः
स्नायीत यो वै हरते बिसानि ॥

meaning.en: "Let the Brahmin give his daughter to an Adhvaryu, or to a Chandoga who has kept celibacy, and bathe after studying the Atharva Veda, who has taken the lotus stalks."

verses.text: ऋषय ऊचुः

meaning.en: The sages said:

verses.text:
इष्टमेतद्द्विजातीनां योऽयं ते शपथः कृतः ।
त्वया कृतं बिसस्तैन्यं सर्वेषां नः शुनःसख ॥

meaning.en: "This oath you have taken, Shunahsakha, is what the twice-born approve; the theft of the stalks was done by you, for all of us."

verses.text: शुनःसख उवाच

meaning.en: Shunahsakha said:

verses.text:
न्यस्तमाद्यमपश्यद्भिर्यदुक्तं कृतकर्मभिः ।
सत्यमेतन्न मिथ्यैतद्बिसस्तैन्यं कृतं मया ॥

meaning.en: "What was said by those who had not seen the stalks laid down, men of good deeds, is true and not false: the theft was done by me."

verses.text:
मया ह्यन्तर्हितानीह बिसानीमानि पश्यत ।
परीक्षार्थं भगवतां कृतमेतन्मयानघाः ।
रक्षणार्थं च सर्वेषां भवतामहमागतः ॥

meaning.en: "Look, I have hidden these stalks here. I did this to test you, venerable ones, sinless; and I came to protect all of you."

verses.text:
यातुधानी ह्यतिक्रुद्धा कृत्यैषा वो वधैषिणी ।
वृषादर्भिप्रयुक्तैषा निहता मे तपोधनाः ॥

meaning.en: "This Yatudhani, a Kritya sent by Vrishadarbhi, was furious and wished to kill you; I have slain her, you rich in austerity."

verses.text:
दुष्टा हिंस्यादियं पापा युष्मान्प्रत्यग्निसंभवा ।
तस्मादस्म्यागतो विप्रा वासवं मां निबोधत ॥

meaning.en: "That wicked creature born of fire would have harmed you; therefore I have come. Know me, Brahmins, as Vasava, Indra."

verses.text:
अलोभादक्षया लोकाः प्राप्ता वः सार्वकामिकाः ।
उत्तिष्ठध्वमितः क्षिप्रं तानवाप्नुत वै द्विजाः ॥

meaning.en: "By your freedom from greed, you have won the imperishable worlds that fulfil every wish. Rise quickly from here and attain them, Brahmins."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततो महर्षयः प्रीतास्तथेत्युक्त्वा पुरंदरम् ।
सहैव त्रिदशेन्द्रेण सर्वे जग्मुस्त्रिविष्टपम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the great sages, pleased, said "So be it" to Indra and all went with the lord of the gods to heaven.

verses.text:
एवमेते महात्मानो भोगैर्बहुविधैरपि ।
क्षुधा परमया युक्ताश्छन्द्यमाना महात्मभिः ।
नैव लोभं तदा चक्रुस्ततः स्वर्गमवाप्नुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Thus those great-souled ones, though tempted by many kinds of enjoyment while gripped by extreme hunger, never gave way to greed, and so attained heaven.

verses.text:
तस्मात्सर्वास्ववस्थासु नरो लोभं विवर्जयेत् ।
एष धर्मः परो राजन्नलोभ इति विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: Therefore a man should avoid greed in every circumstance; absence of greed, O king, is renowned as the highest dharma.

verses.text:
इदं नरः सच्चरितं समवायेषु कीर्तयेत् ।
सुखभागी च भवति न च दुर्गाण्यवाप्नुते ॥

meaning.en: A man who recites this good conduct in assemblies becomes a sharer in happiness and meets no hardships.

verses.text:
प्रीयन्ते पितरश्चास्य ऋषयो देवतास्तथा ।
यशोधर्मार्थभागी च भवति प्रेत्य मानवः ॥

meaning.en: His ancestors, the sages and the gods are pleased, and after death that man shares in fame, dharma and prosperity.
